title: chore(ui-i18n): the call-site key gate refuses a lazy-namespace key read outside its namespace's frame
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao4D7g8Jw4AoTpqTHJgB4GVG)_

Fixes #30645

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：i18n 调用点门禁（`check:i18n-keys`）新增第 9 类 `namespace-key-outside-frame`：只存在于懒加载命名空间（目前是 marketplace）里的 key，如果在该命名空间的「框」目录之外被 `t()` 读取，门禁直接变红。
- 为什么改：#30640 把大部分 `marketplace.*` 文案移进了懒加载包，只有两个市场页面会拉取它；别的页面（比如 Studio、Setup）一旦复用其中某个 key，用户会看到原始 key，而原有的各道 i18n 门禁都把命名空间当成常驻包，全部是绿的。
- 风险与回滚：只改门禁脚本和它的测试，不发布任何包、不改运行时；当前树上 0 条新发现。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` 的 `PACK_NAMESPACE_FRAMES`（命名空间与它的框声明在同一张表里）、`analyze()` 里的 `judgeFrame` 三处调用点，以及测试文件里新的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui check:i18n-keys`，预期退出 0，并打印一行 `Namespace frames: 1 pack-shaped namespace(s) — packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/ read 183 time(s) inside its frame`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`:

- The one list of pack-shaped namespaces now carries each namespace's frame: `PACK_NAMESPACE_FRAMES` maps the namespace directory to the source directories that render under the gate fetching it (marketplace: `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/`). `PACK_NAMESPACE_DIRS` is derived from its keys, so every existing reader (`collectEnKeys`, `check-i18n-en-drift.mjs`, `check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs`) reads the same list, and a namespace cannot be added without its frame. `analyze()` throws on a namespace declared with an empty frame.
- `collectEnKeys` also returns `namespaceOf`: which namespace each namespace-defined leaf lives in.
- New class 9, `namespace-key-outside-frame`, HARD from day one (no baseline). A call site outside a namespace's frame is refused when it asks for a key that only that namespace answers: a literal key (plural forms included: refused when every form that resolves is namespace-only), a `returnObjects` subtree, or a template head with no resident leaf under it. A key the resident pack answers is never refused.
- A live control: the run prints `Namespace frames:` with how many call-site keys each frame reads, and fails as a collapsed scan when a declared namespace's frame reads none.
- Header, `HINTS` entry and its own failure paragraph for the class.

Division of labour with `marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts` (unchanged): this gate judges every file OUTSIDE the frame directories; the boundary test keeps judging the files INSIDE `console/marketplace/` that a page outside the frame imports.

## Tests

`ui/scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts`, new describe `a key only a namespace defines is refused outside its frame (objectstack#30645)`, 10 cases on synthetic repos and the real tree:

- positive control: a namespace-only key spelled in `packages/studio/src/page.tsx` turns the class red, naming the namespace;
- the same key inside the frame is silent and counted in `framedReads`; a resident key outside the frame is silent;
- plural base, template head (namespace-only vs one a resident leaf answers), `returnObjects` subtree;
- a second namespace (`billing`) declared with its own frame is judged with no other change;
- a namespace declared with an empty frame throws;
- one list read both ways (`PACK_NAMESPACE_DIRS` equals the frame map's keys, every frame non-empty);
- on this tree: 0 findings of the class, and every frame reads at least one key.

Real-tree probe (one-off, file removed afterwards, not committed): a file `packages/app-shell/src/console/Probe30645.tsx` calling `t('marketplace.title')` made `node scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` exit 1 with `[namespace-key-outside-frame]  marketplace.title`; with the file removed it exits 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Not judged by the new class, by construction: a key built by a helper or spelled in a table and passed to `t()` as a variable. That is the same blind spot class 1 (`missing-key`) has; the boundary test's literal scan still reads such spellings inside `console/marketplace/`.
- A declared dynamic family whose head is resident but some of whose members are namespace-only is not judged member by member; the head is passed because a resident leaf answers it.

## Verification

Head `f4a22f9b`, tree `objectstack-ai/objectstack`.

<details><summary>Derived gates: 20 of 20 exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 20 lines from the 2 changed files. All 20 exited 0, among them `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (under the verify lock: Test Files 170 passed, 2 skipped; Tests 4989 passed, 2 skipped; `VERDICT command-exit 0`). `dispatch-gates --ran` printed `20 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.

Run beyond the derivation, all exit 0 on the final head: `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `pnpm --dir ui check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`, `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:scripts`. The scripts type-check was red once on an earlier head (the new return field and the frame map were untyped in JSDoc) and is green on `f4a22f9b`.

</details>

<details><summary>Not run locally</summary>

`marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts` is unchanged. Locally it stops at import (`@objectstack/spec/ui` has no dist in this worktree), so it is NOT MEASURED here and Test UI runs it.

</details>

No published package changes (`ui/scripts/` belongs to the private `object-ui-monorepo` root), hence `skip-changeset`.
